column3: “a mark of leprosy” renders “a plague of tsara’at,” here a mold or mildew in a house (also in verses 35–53).
“the plaster” renders “the dust (afar)” (also in verses 42 and 45).
“indeed” renders an emphatic doubled verb, and “has not reappeared” renders “has been healed.”
“cleanse” renders “cleanse from sin” (also in verse 52), and “a scarlet string” renders “scarlet of the worm.”
“the law” renders “the torah (instruction),” and “a scale” renders “netheq,” a scall.
“the law of leprosy” renders “the torah of tsara’at.”
